I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

I'll retry writing the top-level Makefile.

Now the remaining manual fixes.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`. `make -j8`, `make check`, `make install` and `make DEBUG=1` all work from a clean tree, and `/app/STATUS.json` says `"success"`.

**Verification**
- Each target built from a clean tree at `-j1`, `-j8` and `-j32` without failures. The targets were `build/lib/libqs.a`, `build/bin/colstat`, `build/bin/qcalc`, `check` and `install`.
- `make check` passes in release and in debug: 22 unit tests and 34 golden cases, none failing.
- A second `make` with nothing changed runs no compile, archive or link step.
- Changing `VERSION`, `src/ops.def` or a header rebuilds only what depends on it. A `DEBUG=1` build followed by a plain `make` rebuilds everything with the other flags.
- `make install PREFIX=/usr DESTDIR=/tmp/stage` produced exactly the documented files with the documented modes. `qs.pc` recorded `/usr`. A test program built against the installed header and `libqs.a` ran correctly.

**Build fixes**
- **Stale header:** I deleted `include/qs/ops.h`, an old hand-kept copy that could shadow the generated one and had a different operation table.
- **Generated headers:** `build/gen/qs/version.h` previously had no rule at all. Both generated headers are now built before anything that includes them.
- **Compile and link:** the tools and tests now get the generated-header include path. Header changes are tracked through dependency files. Programs link statically with the library before `-lm`. Objects rebuild when the compiler or flags change.
- **`DEBUG`:** `DEBUG=1` now works. Before, only `DEBUG=yes` did.
- **`check`:** it no longer ignores a failing unit test or the golden exit status. It builds what the tests need and runs both suites.
- **`install`:** it no longer builds `qs.pc` as part of `all`. It writes `qs.pc` with the `PREFIX` given to `make install`, and installs `version.h` and both man pages. Before, only `colstat.1` was installed.
- **Source discovery:** source files are found recursively, so adding a file needs no makefile edit.

**Source fixes (warnings and behavior)**
- Missing `<stdlib.h>` and an unused parameter in `strbuf.c`.
- A switch fallthrough in `size.c`. I also made it reject sizes that overflow instead of silently wrapping.
- Variables unused under `NDEBUG` in `summary.c` and `colstat/main.c`.
- `%d` used for `size_t` in several places.
- Sign-compare warnings, an assignment inside a `while` condition, and a switch missing `TOK_END`.
- Prefix `-` now takes operators that bind strictly tighter than `neg` in `src/ops.def`, as `docs/qcalc.md` says. It gives the same results as before for the current table. Changing `neg` to precedence 40 turns `-2^2` into 4, so the table now drives it.

The main uncertainty is in the `qcalc` evaluator. It lexes the whole line before evaluating, so a bad character is reported even when an earlier division by zero would also fail. The docs don't settle which error comes first, so I left that order alone.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100 && cat docs/BUILDING.md && git status | head -5

cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './tests/golden/*' | sort; cat Makefile; ls mk; cat mk/* ; cat build-aux/* src/ops.def VERSION qs.pc.in; cat docs/colstat.md docs/qcalc.md; head -40 tests/golden.sh
cd /app && cat include/qs/*.h; wc -l lib/*/* tools/*/* tests/unit/*
cd /app && rm include/qs/ops.h && for f in lib/core/* lib/csv/* lib/expr/* lib/num/* lib/stats/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat -A $f | sed 's/\$$//' ; done
cd /app && tail -n +62 lib/csv/reader.c; cat lib/csv/row.c lib/expr/eval.c lib/expr/expr_int.h lib/expr/lexer.c; sed -n 1,45p lib/expr/parser.c
cd /app && for f in lib/ops/*.c tools/*/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

cd /app && cat tests/unit/*; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.a /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.a; gcc --version | head -1; make --version | head -1; awk --version 2>&1 | head -1; ls -la; cat .gitignore

cd /app && sed -i -E 's/reserve\((sb, [^,]+), "[a-z]+"\)/reserve(\1)/' lib/core/strbuf.c && grep -n reserve lib/core/strbuf.c; sed -i 's/for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)/for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)/' lib/stats/moments.c; sed -i 's/for (int i = 0; i < qs_op_count(); i++)/for (size_t i = 0; i < qs_op_count(); i++)/' lib/ops/table.c; sed -i 's/while (c = s\[i\])/while ((c = s[i]) != '"'\\\\0'"')/' lib/expr/lexer.c; grep -n 'while ((c' lib/expr/lexer.c; sed -i 's/count=%d", name/count=%zu", name/' tools/colstat/report.c; sed -i 's/%d tokens/%zu tokens/' lib/expr/eval.c; sed -i 's/qcalc: line %d/qcalc: line %zu/' tools/qcalc/repl.c; git diff --stat 2>/dev/null | tail -1
cd /app && make -j8 2>&1 | tail -40; echo rc=$?; make -j8 check 2>&1 | tail -80
cd /app && sed -i 's/#include <stdio.h>/#include <stdio.h>\n#include <stdlib.h>/' lib/core/strbuf.c && head -8 lib/core/strbuf.c; make -k -j8 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A8 'error\|Error' | head -80
cd /app && make clean >/dev/null && make -j8 check >/tmp/chk.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; grep -v '^gcc\|^PASS' /tmp/chk.log | tail -30; grep -c PASS /tmp/chk.log; grep FAIL /tmp/chk.log

cd /app && make -j8 2>&1 | tail -3; echo ---second; make 2>&1 | tail; echo ---debug; make clean >/dev/null; make DEBUG=1 -j8 2>&1 | grep -i 'error\|warning' | grep -v 'Werror -MMD' ; ls build/bin; make DEBUG=1 check 2>&1 | grep -c PASS; echo ---switch; make 2>&1 | grep -c '^gcc'; make 2>&1 | wc -l

cd /app && make clean >/dev/null; make -j8 >/dev/null 2>&1; 
sed -i '1s/.*/2.5.0/' VERSION; make 2>&1 | grep -c '^gcc'; build/bin/qcalc --version; build/bin/colstat --version
cp src/ops.def /tmp/ops.def.bak; sed -i 's/^neg .*/neg     -       1   40  right   qs_op_neg/' src/ops.def; make >/dev/null 2>&1; build/bin/qcalc -e '-2^2'; build/bin/qcalc --ops | sed -n 6p
cp /tmp/ops.def.bak src/ops.def; make >/dev/null 2>&1; build/bin/qcalc -e '-2^2'
touch include/qs/num.h; make 2>&1 | grep -c '^gcc'; echo 2.4.1 > VERSION; make >/dev/null; build/bin/qcalc --version
for t in build/lib/libqs.a build/bin/colstat build/bin/qcalc check install; do for j in 1 8 32; do make clean >/dev/null; make -j$j $t DESTDIR=/tmp/st >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo FAIL $t $j; done; done; echo done

cd /app && make clean >/dev/null && cat > STATUS.json <<'EOF'
{
  "status": "success",
  "summary": "Rewrote the makefile fragments (generated version.h rule, include paths, dependency files, link order and static linking, flag stamp for DEBUG switching, check that fails on any failure, install with PREFIX/DESTDIR and pc/man handling), deleted the stale hand-kept include/qs/ops.h, and fixed the warnings and bugs in the sources (strbuf, size parsing fallthrough/overflow, unused variables under NDEBUG, format specifiers, sign comparisons, switch coverage, prefix-minus precedence). Verified clean builds of every target at -j1/8/32, make check in release and debug, incremental rebuilds, a no-op second make, and the install tree."
}
EOF
ls; cat STATUS.json | head -3
